sections.title: Species traits
lines: Small Humanoid (Gnome), also called imago. Base land speed 20 ft. +2 Dexterity, +2 Constitution, +2 Charisma, −2 Strength.
Small size gives +1 to AC and attacks and +4 size on Hide. Use Small weapons and three-quarters of Medium lifting and carrying capacity.
Low-light vision doubles normal human range and preserves color and detail.
Weapon Familiarity makes the gnome hooked hammer a martial weapon.
+4 dodge AC against Giant-type creatures while retaining the Dexterity bonus to AC.
+2 racial bonus on Listen checks and immunity to confusion effects.
Luck of Chaos (Ex) allows one reroll per day of a roll the gnome just made, before the DM announces success or failure. Keep the new result even if it is worse.
Spell Power adds +1 effective caster level to spells with the chaos descriptor. It applies to level-dependent spell variables and caster level checks and stacks with other Spell Power abilities.

Entropic shield is available 1/day regardless of Charisma. At Charisma 10 or higher, daze, flare, and prestidigitation are also available 1/day each. These are caster level 1. Save DC where applicable is 10 + Charisma modifier + spell level.
Common and Gnome are automatic. Bonus languages are Any. Favored class Sorcerer. Level adjustment +1. The entry grants no racial Hit Dice.

sections.title: Original NPC · Orrin Redwick
lines: Lantern mender and Sorcerer.
Motive. Salvage the paper lanterns that were left under a leaking roof before the procession assembles.
Hook. Orrin can repair the route lanterns if the party finds him somewhere dry to work.
Chaos Gnome lantern mender, Sorcerer 1 · Provisional CR 2. ECL 2. · Small Humanoid (Gnome)
AC 14 · HP 6 (1d4+2) · Speed 20 ft.

sections.title: Original NPC · Pella Reedchime
lines: Roadside mediator and Cleric.
Motive. Resolve a dispute over damaged cargo before sunset strands both wagons at the bridge.
Hook. Pella can keep the crossing open if the party helps count the damaged goods in front of both drivers.
Chaos Gnome roadside mediator, Cleric 1 · Provisional CR 2. ECL 2. · Small Humanoid (Gnome)
AC 18 · HP 10 (1d8+2) · Speed 20 ft.
